items.title: W. R. Berkley (WRB) Is Up 5.1% After Earnings Beat And Ongoing Buybacks Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: In the past quarter, W. R. Berkley Corporation reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of US$3,716.12 million and net income of US$452.26 million, with both basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations rising year over year. Alongside stronger earnings, the company continued shrinking its share count, having repurchased US$111.5 million of stock in the latest quarter and roughly US$4.74 billion since 2006, which can enhance per-share results over time.
